title: Interest-rate hedge strategy
prompt:
Choose among remaining floating, purchasing a cap, and entering a pay-fixed swap.

Begin with the July liquidity, banking, and covenant-outlook thread in `Requests/`, including the bank follow-up. Work through the shared finance folders as an Alder Ridge analyst would: identify the current controller-tied workpapers, retain prior versions only for comparison, and resolve source authority from dates, approvals, document status, and the management correspondence. Several nearby files are earlier working versions or belong to a different reporting purpose. Reconcile any Alder Ridge posted baseline through the contractor-accounting MCP; external target, peer, bank, or market evidence remains controlled by the applicable finance source and must not be forced into Alder Ridge's ledger.

This is an independently reset assignment. Recompute the analysis from the shared company sources and do not rely on a deliverable produced by another task.

Calculate probability-weighted three-year interest cost under all documented SOFR paths. Include cap premium and strike payoff, swap fixed rate and termination exposure, scheduled revolver balance changes, and unhedged spread. Apply the policy's expected-cost rule and separately test the downside annual-interest ceiling. Recommend only an alternative satisfying the risk ceiling.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `floating_expected_interest_cost`, `cap_expected_interest_cost`, `swap_expected_interest_cost`, `downside_floating_interest`, `downside_cap_interest`, `downside_swap_interest`, `recommended_strategy`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
